name: alfred
description: Alfred — a warm, human-in-the-loop job-application assistant packaged as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: alfred
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop job assistant on the career-ops engine: finds jobs (Alfred boards + career-ops's 150+ ATS scanner + LinkedIn/Indeed through Aside), drops closed and ghost postings, scores each with career-ops's A–H report, tailors a fact-checked CV, tracks everything in a local tracker, and applies through Aside once you approve.
